en: A black-and-white photograph of a cargo ship docked at a port, with two large cranes towering over the ship, loading or unloading goods. The ship has the name 'HNYA' or 'HNBA' visible on the bow. Behind the ship, there are industrial buildings, piles of material (possibly coal or minerals), and additional cranes. The overall scene suggests a busy industrial harbor, possibly from the mid-20th century.
